name: etcd
description: Agent skills for working with etcd: etcdctl key-value operations, cluster health and maintenance, and snapshot backup and restore.

interface.longDescription: Skills for etcd, the distributed reliable key-value store. Covers etcdctl key-value work (get/put/del with prefixes and revisions, watch, transactions, leases, locks and elections, TLS and output flags); cluster maintenance (endpoint health and status, membership changes, leader transfer, NOSPACE alarms, compaction and defragmentation, hash and performance checks); and snapshot backup and restore with etcdctl and etcdutl, including revision bumping for Kubernetes control planes.
defaultPrompt: Check the health of my etcd cluster
Our etcd hit a NOSPACE alarm, help me recover
Take an etcd snapshot and show me how to restore it
